question: Who became the Chief Minister of Goa after March 2022 elections?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Pramod Sawant.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Pramod Sawant **became the** Chief Minister of Goa** after the** March 2022 assembly elections**.
 
• He belongs to the** Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP)** and won the elections from his constituency Sanquelim.
 
• Sawant was previously the **Speaker of the Goa Legislative Assembly **and was sworn in as the **Chief Minister on March 19, 2022,** after the resignation of the previous Chief Minister, Pramod Sawant.
 
• Sawant's appointment as **Chief Minister** was seen as a surprise move by the BJP, as he was not seen as a front-runner for the post. 
 
• However, he was able to secure the support of the** majority of the MLAs** in the assembly and form a government.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Laxmikant Parsekar **was the** Chief Minister of Goa** from 2014 to 2017.

 
 
• He** lost the 2017 assembly elections **from his constituency Mandrem and also **lost the 2022 assembly** elections from the same constituency.
 
 
 
• **Digambar Kamat** was the **Chief Minister of Goa** from 2007 to 2012.
 
 
• He won the **2022 assembly elections** from his constituency Margao, but did not become the Chief Minister.
 
 
 
• **Manohar Parrikar** was the Chief Minister of Goa from** 2012 to 2014,** and from **2017 **until his death in 2019.
